name: Child mortality (per 1000 live births)
description: This is the probability of dying between birth and exactly five years of age expressed per 1000 live births

The number of maternal deaths divided by the number of live births in a given year, multiplied by 100,000. Maternal death is defined as the death of a women while pregnant or within the 42 days after termination of that pregnancy, regardless of the length and site of the pregnancy, from a cause related to or aggravated by the pregnancy.
name: Maternal mortality ratio (per 100 000 live births)
Babies per woman, total fertility
description: This is the number of children that  would be born to a woman if she were to live to the end of her childbearing years and bear children in accordance  with age-specific fertility rates of the specified year. It expresses the statisctical indicator total fertility rate.
